The '''Cilare system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cilare]].
